(Cross-referenced against https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-trump-strait-of-hormuz-attacks-persian-gulf/ — search snippet content quoting the underlying Reuters written statement; both outlets are approved sources.)

Sunday 19 July 2026.

US EMBASSY AMMAN SECURITY ALERT: said Jordan is "evacuating the King Hussein
International Airport and seaport in the Red Sea resort town of Aqaba due to a
specific and credible threat." The embassy advised Americans to avoid both sites and
all military installations in Jordan.
(Primary source https://jo.usembassy.gov/security-alert-u-s-embassy-amman-july-19-2026/
returned "Technical Difficulties" and was not retrieved directly.)

JORDANIAN GOVERNMENT DENIAL — government spokesperson Dr Mohammad Al-Momani, in a
written statement to Reuters:
DIRECT QUOTE: "No potential threats have been recorded by the relevant Jordanian
authorities in the past few hours."
DIRECT QUOTE: "The airport and port are operating normally."
Al-Momani said the authorities had not issued any evacuation orders at Aqaba airport
or the port.

FURTHER CONTRADICTION: the director general of the Aqaba Company for Ports told
Reuters the seaport was operating normally and had not been evacuated.

CONTEXT: The US military said on Saturday that two of its personnel were killed in
Jordan and another was missing after an Iranian attack.

NOTE ON TIMING: the exact BST timestamps of the embassy alert and the Jordanian
denial could not be pinned down. Treated as "Sunday afternoon" in the brief; no
precise time asserted.
